summary: Continued the interrupted audio-pwa build. Almost everything was already on disk and complete: all 24 SfxName recipes (src/audio/sfx.ts), generative ThemePlayer per MusicTheme with crossfade, duck and tab-hidden pause (music.ts, context.ts), Web Speech with es-ES voice selection, queue, character pitch/rate, emoji/markup stripping and maths reading (speech.ts, speechText.ts, voices.ts), haptics (haptics.ts), unlockAudio/applyAudioSettings/setMasterVolume/audioState (index.ts), themed celebrate and stopCelebrations with star particles and a reduced-motion glow (src/fx). This session I verified it and did not change any source. Gallery renders on iPad. Production build precaches fonts, models and icons. Offline reload works. Recommended changes to integrator-owned files are listed under contractRequests.
publicApi: src/audio/index.ts: unlockAudio(): void; applyAudioSettings({sound,music,voice}): void; setMasterVolume(v): void (extra); audioState(): 'off'|'locked'|'suspended'|'running' (extra); re-exports sfx, music, speech, haptics. src/fx/index.ts: celebrate(kind), type CelebrationKind, stopCelebrations() (extra). Dev/QA only: src/audio/devtools.ts, offline.ts (renderSfx/renderTheme/analyse), testing/mockAudio.ts, testing/mockSpeech.ts.
tests: npx vitest run src/audio src/fx: 9 files, 159 tests passed. npm run typecheck filtered to src/audio and src/fx: zero errors. npx vite build: succeeded, 91 precache entries (about 2.9 MB) including fonts/*.woff, models/digits/model.{json,bin} and icons. Offline test with vite preview on :4173 and Playwright: after the service worker takes control, setOffline plus reload loads with no page errors, and document.fonts.check('16px Fredoka') is true. Gallery screenshot /dev/gallery?only=src/audio on iPad viewport checked visually (shots/audio-ipad.png). Note: tools/shot.mjs hardcodes a Linux Chromium path that does not exist on this Mac, so I ran a copy in the scratchpad pointing at ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1243. The tool itself is unchanged.
openIssues: Real-device listening and iOS speech-voice checks are not possible in this container; speech voice selection (Mónica on iPad) and haptics on Android are untested on hardware.
The app shell served offline is a placeholder WelcomeScreen owned by another module, so the offline test only proves the shell and assets are cached, not the full app.
Vite warns that the main chunk is 592 kB (over 500 kB). Not from audio code; integrator may want code-splitting.
tools/shot.mjs hardcodes /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 which does not exist on this machine; other agents will hit the same error.
contractRequests: index.html: remove maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no from the viewport meta (WCAG 1.4.4 resize text, low-vision families). Keep viewport-fit=cover and width=device-width.

vite.config.ts workbox: add navigateFallbackDenylist: [/^\/dev\//] so the dev-only /dev/gallery route is not served by the service worker fallback in production, and consider excluding src/**/*.gallery chunks from the production build (they are lazy but still ship).

vite.config.ts workbox: globPatterns already covers woff, models (json/bin) and icons; no change needed. Optionally add 'favicon.svg' and 'icons/apple-touch-icon.png' to includeAssets so the iOS home-screen icon is available offline.

tools/shot.mjs: replace the hardcoded executablePath '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome' with the Playwright default (omit executablePath) or an env var, so screenshots run on any machine.
